import json
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Get trending repos (last 7 days)
seven_days_ago = (datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=7)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
url_trending = f'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=created:>{seven_days_ago}&sort=stars&order=desc&per_page=5'

print('=== TRENDING (Last 7 Days) ===')
with urllib.request.urlopen(url_trending) as response:
    data = json.loads(response.read())

        print(f\"  Desc: {repo['description']}\")
        print(f\"  Lang: {repo['language']}\")
        print()
"
